title: fix: revoke community model publishing access
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes rodrigookk from the community-model publisher allowlist
- Prevents the account from making private endpoints public again
- Existing public listings were separately changed to private in production

gist.headline: The garden gate closes
gist.blurb: A community-model publishing permission has been tidied up. The hive's public shelves stay intentionally curated.
gist.summary: Removed the rodrigookk account from the community-model publisher allowlist, preventing its private endpoints from being republished publicly.
gist.impact: Public community-model listings remain curated, while the affected account's endpoints stay private after their production listings were moved back behind the garden fence.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper closing a small wooden gate beside a cozy community model garden, with private code-plants safely behind the fence and approved public flowers blooming outside. A tiny allowlist clipboard and a retro terminal can show that publishing access is being managed deliberately.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny gardener hat and gently closing a wooden garden gate beside private code-plants and a retro terminal with an allowlist clipboard. Lime green (#ecf874) flowers bloom around the curated public garden, with soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, emotionally warm.
